preregistered_plan.scientific_goal: Independently separate original native 8-node Cartesian source/receiver geometry interpolation error from singular free-space retarded point Green physics, before assuming additional numeric spatial schemes can fix the original 250ms broadband q0 problem. Compute all five SHA-pinned actual native HDF5 eightpoint weights in analytic continuum 3D retarded Green, plus exactly one first-image planar reflection per true Neumann face with specular-foot validity; DO NOT use finite-reflection model as full-room 250ms physical qualification.

retarded_reference.equation: free-space retarded wave Green in 3D G(r,t)=δ(t-r/c)/(4πr) at r>0; for signed exp(+iωt) time Fourier integral G+(ω,r)=exp(+iωr/c)/(4πr). Point impulse native pressure derivative multiplies common -iω rho; normalized eightnode-vs-true-point ratio cancels unknown fixed q0 physical force scale.
retarded_reference.original_eightnode_spatial_functional: sum_{i=0..7,j=0..7} original_in_sigs[i,0]/sum(in_sigs[:,0]) * original_out_alpha[j] * exp(+iω||x_i-x_j||/c)/(4π||x_i-x_j||); original eight points and real comms/voxel SHAs verified
retarded_reference.first_reflections: six individual rigid planar image sources x=0 x=4 y=0 y=4 z=0 z=4-.25*y, reflect geometric source through corresponding infinite plane then receiver; specular reflection foot on finite original wall face required, compute from image source to receiver and line-plane intersection
retarded_reference.causal_arrival: direct travel 1/c and shortest single valid image arrival; direct-only continuum valid before first reflected arrival (in simple constant-c geometric acoustics) but not full native 250ms Neumann response
retarded_reference.record: report all five original HDF5 spatially weighted signed 40/80 image/direct coefficients and unweighted true-point baseline plus both finite 250ms original saved signed native P_T/Q_T. Signed complex 40/80 intrinsic original three gates recomputed unchanged; analytic direct field is diagnostic only, not an alternate pass criterion.
retarded_reference.geometry: true 56m3 wedge x0..4 y0..4 0<=z<=4-.25y; reflective walls individually planar first bounce
retarded_reference.finite_record_interpretation: retarded one-shot direct pulse reaches receiver within original T, so unwindowed distributional first-arrival integral equals infinite-time direct Green; reflected and multibounce path contributions in 250ms unknown from first images alone; no whole-room physical equivalence claim
